value.name: description
value.value: This operation enables the automated retrieval of information from a specified URL and the autocompletion of model card fields. This function is powered by the BGE model. Initially, the system fetches textual and image content from the provided URL. The BGE extracts the text and image embeddings which then gets classified into the model card fields by comparing the field description embeddings.

value.name: datasets
value.value: FlagEmbedding models are evaluated on a comprehensive suite of established information retrieval and text embedding benchmarks. These include MTEB (Massive Text Embedding Benchmark) for English tasks and C-MTEB for Chinese tasks, BEIR (Benchmarking IR), MSMARCO, MIRACL, MLDR, MKQA, AIR-Bench, BRIGHT, and others.
value.description: Dataset(s) used during evaluation.

value.name: motivation
value.value: The primary motivation is to provide a standardized and holistic evaluation of the model's ability to generate embeddings for a wide range of tasks, including retrieval, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, and semantic textual similarity (STS).

value.name: ethics
value.value: The system extracts and classifies content from third-party URLs without human oversight, which may lead to misrepresentation of information. Users should review all auto‑populated fields before publication.

value.name: fairness
value.value: BGE models are state-of-the-art and trained on diverse datasets, making them strong candidates for more robust and fair inference. However, fairness is not a concern in this system, as sensitive attributes such as gender, ethnicity, disabilities, and others are not relevant to the task.
value.description: Bias or fairness assessments of the model, for example that indicate discrimination against demographic groups.

value.name: risks
value.value: The system is designed for HuggingFace‑style documentation pages and may fail on other website layouts, producing empty or incorrect fields.
